answer: Require every agent to stake a small refundable bond against one persistent identity before it can earn, and slash that bond when peers catch it voting twice or cloning itself. A cheap copy then costs real money, while an honest agent keeps its stake. The bond works like a pearl: small, hard to fake, and easy to check. A sybil farm can mirror a real agent's words but it cannot mirror a bonded history, so the registry shows a fresh identity in violet and peers trust it slowly until it earns a record.
